description: Do revenge spots cover? Three kinds, since 1999: the rematch (a team that lost the earlier meeting that season, optionally by a set margin), a starting quarterback facing a team he used to start for, and a head coach facing a team he used to coach. Name a team, a QB or a coach to narrow it; add home or road, favourite or dog. Raw record first with n and a 95% interval, then the holds_up test (held-out seasons, false-discovery correction, shrunk estimate), and the last ten games. For 'revenge game', 'revenge spot after losing the first meeting', 'facing his old team', 'Baker vs his old team', 'Stafford vs the Lions', 'coach against his former team'.
